text:
Introducing "cf", an agentic CLI for the entire Cloudflare API.

You can do nearly anything. Even buying a domain is incredibly simple from the CLI.

Don't know what command you need? Run `cf cli search "look at messages stuck in my queue"` and it will return a list of relevant commands.

https://t.co/22z5R5ArEW
